title: ML Incident API Audit Event
description: Schema for structured audit log events emitted by src/audit.py. Used for SIEM ingestion, compliance audit trails, and security event documentation. CI-52: introduced 2026-05-28.

event.description: Dot-notation event name, e.g. authentication.success, token.revoked

event_type.description: Coarse event category for SIEM routing and filtering

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp injected by structlog processor

user_id.description: UUID of the authenticated user. Null if user is not yet identified (e.g. failed login before lookup).

ip_address.description: Client IP address as seen by the API (may be X-Forwarded-For if behind a proxy)

mfa_used.description: Whether MFA was used for this authentication (auth events only)

reason.description: Human-readable reason string for failure/revocation events

attempted_email_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the attempted login email. Never the raw email address.

token_jti.description: JWT jti (JWT ID) claim. Not the full token string.

endpoint.description: API endpoint path that triggered the event (rate_limit and authz events)

limit.description: Rate limit threshold that was exceeded (rate_limit events)

window_seconds.description: Rate limit window duration in seconds (rate_limit events)

required_role.description: Role required to access the endpoint (authz events)

actual_role.description: Role the requesting user actually holds (authz events)
